02 THE PERSON

Logic on one side.
Instinct on the other.

I don’t fit into just one frame.

I’m Raghuraj, a Computer Science & Engineering (AI & ML) student at AKGEC. I build cross-platform apps with Flutter and Firebase, and explore how AI can make everyday experiences more useful.

Off the keyboard, I’m behind a camera or deep in an edit. Brand stories, campus films, a moment worth saving — I’m here for the frame, the rhythm, and the feeling.
